summary.en: At the previous day's prom at the Daigo residence, Yu Daigo was struck by love at first sight with a mysterious girl. However, she had to leave early for some reason and only left one of her shoes behind. This is the reason why Kogoro and Conan are at the mansion. Yu recalls that after he finished discussing work with his secretary over the phone, she ran away from the prom. Coincidentally, Daigo's call with his secretary contained terms that Reira may have misinterpreted as Daigo having a call with legal officials, leading him to believe that she was in some kind of legal trouble.
